page.overview:
Who is Tokie?

Tokie is a young girl with fair skin and a small, petite build. She has long straight black hair with four thin strands over her forehead and long bangs framing her face.

Tokie wore a lime-green kimono with a blue obi on the night of her kidnapping. She also wore a long, dark-red haori over her attire.

Tokie is shown to be a very prudent girl, as she obeyed her mother's request to stay home at night due to the series of disappearances during that period. She is also kind and caring, as shown when she wonders about whereabouts of the missing girls kidnapped by the Swamp Demon and hopes that they are alright.

Tokie is first seen leaving her family members to go to sleep, having just been told to stay indoors due to the disappearances that had been happening during the night. She obeys and sadly thinks about the girls who had already been kidnapped, hoping that no other girl would be taken as she gets into bed. As she's falling asleep, the Swamp Demon creates a swamp pool under her futon and pulls her under, much to her horror. She is defenseless to escape his grasp despite her struggling and is successfully knocked out and dragged into the depths.
